title: Multi-Charge Allowance on Home-Visit Settlements — Specimen Collection Appointments
content:
Questions and answers on the multi-charge allowance, **Specimen Collection Appointments** (Mobile In-Home Collection Visit).

**What sets the allowance?** How many of the visit's service charges — its trip, additional-patient and weekend charges — stand assessed on the visit's fee record.

**What are the rates?**

| Assessed service charges on the visit (trip, additional-patient, weekend) | Multi-charge allowance |
|---|---|
| All three | 3 percent |
| Two of them | 1 percent |
| A single charge | None |

**The clause.** A settlement covering three assessed service charges on the visit (trip, additional-patient and weekend) carries an allowance of 3 percent, one covering two of them carries 1 percent, and one covering a single charge carries none.

**Examples (hypothetical visits).**

- A Sunday visit with household members drawn, carrying an assessed trip fee, an assessed additional-patient fee and an assessed weekend surcharge: 3 percent.
- A Saturday visit with no household member, carrying an assessed trip fee and an assessed weekend surcharge: 1 percent.
- A weekday visit carrying only an assessed trip fee: none.
